extra_quotes: Evaluations on real UPMEM hardware show that PIVOT filters out 99.3–99.7% of probed vectors and achieves up to 18.8× and 10.2× the QPS of CPU and prior PIM baselines, respectively.
We conduct all experiments on a dual-socket server with two Intel Xeon Silver 4216 CPUs at 2.10 GHz, 251 GiB of DDR4 memory, and 20 UPMEM DIMMs containing 2,543 operational DPUs at 400 MHz.
